title: Nine Red Lantern halo islands on P3
desc: Nine versions of the floating halo-ring island, each with room for many red lanterns on top, red prison cells underneath and an enraged mob field below.

takes.name: Halo rings
takes.facts: P3 as it was, lanterns in three rings, twelve cells round the rim; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Full disc
takes.facts: hole closed: the most floor for lanterns, small altar under the beam; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Amphitheatre
takes.facts: terraces stepping up to the hole, a lantern row on every step; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Spoked wheel
takes.facts: outer ring + six spokes to a hub, lanterns along the spokes; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Lantern field
takes.facts: octagon deck, lanterns on a square grid, cells as one gallery; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Crescent gate
takes.facts: ring opened by a 60 deg gap, a gate for flyers; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Sunken arena
takes.facts: lowered fighting pit inside, lantern ring outside, cells on chains; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Twin halos
takes.facts: smaller upper halo as a lantern gallery, ramps down; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field

takes.name: Great lantern
takes.facts: a giant Red Lantern in the hole, lantern lines radiating out; deck at z 40, beacon beam, rage smoke to a mob field
